A tank is filled by a pipe in 6 hours. After 2 hours a second pipe that fills it in 12 hours is also opened. The total time to fill is (hours)
questions.explanation: In 2 h: 1/3 filled. Remaining 2/3 at 1/4 per hour: 8/3 h; total 2 + 8/3 = 4.67.

questions.question: The average of 10 numbers is 40. When one number is replaced by 90 the average becomes 42. The replaced number was
questions.explanation: Total rises by 20, so the old number was 90 − 20 = 70.
